projects.name: Polaris Forge 1 first HPC data center
projects.quote: The ELN-02 Lease is for the full capacity of our 100 MW data center that was completed and became operational in October 2025, and the ELN-03 Lease is for the full capacity of our 150 MW data center that is also under construction.

projects.name: ELN-02 Lease
projects.quote: The ELN-02 Lease is for the full capacity of our 100 MW data center that was completed and became operational in October 2025, and the ELN-03 Lease is for the full capacity of our 150 MW data center that is also under construction.

projects.name: ELN-02 SPV Lease
projects.counterparty: CoreWeave Compute Acquisition Co. VIII, LLC
projects.quote: On March 30, 2026, the Company and CoreWeave amended the ELN-02 Lease to suspend the term for two of the four data halls covered by the lease (the “ELN-02 Lease Amendment”) and the Company entered into a new datacenter lease with CoreWeave Compute Acquisition Co. VIII, LLC (“CoreWeave SPV”), a wholly owned subsidiary of CoreWeave, for those two data halls on substantially the same terms as the ELN-02 Lease (the “ELN-02 SPV Lease”).

projects.name: Polaris Forge 1 second HPC data center
projects.quote: We continue building our second HPC data center at Polaris Forge 1 to provide an additional 150MW of capacity.

projects.name: ELN-03 Lease
projects.quote: The ELN-02 Lease is for the full capacity of our 100 MW data center that was completed and became operational in October 2025, and the ELN-03 Lease is for the full capacity of our 150 MW data center that is also under construction.

projects.name: Polaris Forge 1 third HPC data center
projects.quote: Our third HPC focused data center facility at Polaris Forge 1, which is expected to provide an additional 150MW of capacity, is currently under construction, with an anticipated ready for service date in calendar year 2027.

projects.name: Building 4 Lease
projects.quote: On August 28, 2025, APLD ELN-02 C LLC, our subsidiary, entered into a third data center lease, the (“Building 4 Lease”) with CoreWeave to deliver an additional 150 MW at Polaris Forge 1, bringing the total capacity under contract at Polaris Forge 1 to 400 MW.

projects.name: Polaris Forge 2
projects.quote: On August 18, 2025, we also announced that we would be breaking ground on our Polaris Forge 2 campus with an initial 200 MW data center near Harwood, North Dakota.

projects.name: Polaris Forge 2 hyperscaler lease
projects.quote: On October 20, 2025, APLD FAR-01 LLC and APLD FAR-02 LLC, the Company’s subsidiaries, entered into a data center lease with a U.S.-based investment-grade hyperscaler to deliver 200MW of critical IT load to support the hyperscaler’s AI and HPC infrastructure at Polaris Forge 2, which is currently under construction.

projects.name: Delta Forge 1
projects.quote: On January 22, 2026 we announced that we broke ground on Delta Forge 1, a 300 MW critical IT load campus located in a strategic southern U.S. market.

projects.name: Delta Forge 1 hyperscaler leases
projects.quote: On April 20, 2026 and April 22, 2026, APLD AEX-01 LLC and APLD AEX-02 LLC, respectively, each a subsidiary of the Company, entered into separate data center leases with a second U.S.-based investment-grade hyperscaler to deliver a combined 300MW of critical IT load to support the hyperscaler’s AI and HPC infrastructure at Delta Forge 1.

projects.name: Polaris Forge 3
projects.quote: On May 20, 2026, a different subsidiary of the Company entered into a data center lease with the same U.S.-based investment-grade hyperscaler to deliver a combined 300MW of critical IT load to support the second hyperscaler’s AI and HPC infrastructure at Polaris Forge 3.

projects.name: Delta Forge 2
projects.quote: The lease is for the full 210 MW of critical IT load, representing approximately $5.2 billion of contracted revenue over the base term, with expected delivery in the first half of calendar year 2028.

projects.name: Jamestown, North Dakota data center
projects.quote: As of May 31, 2026, our 106 MW facility in Jamestown, North Dakota and our 180 MW facility in Ellendale, North Dakota continue to operate at full capacity.

projects.name: Ellendale, North Dakota data center
projects.quote: As of May 31, 2026, our 106 MW facility in Jamestown, North Dakota and our 180 MW facility in Ellendale, North Dakota continue to operate at full capacity.
